summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the title sequence formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with an Args docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal and returning False without buffering otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in existing modules: test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, mocked wrapper). Not verified by running: pytest, mypy, and Black were not run per instructions, so formatting and type checks are unconfirmed.
